items.title: Buddy Collette interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: Ralph Gleason did a write up on that jazz album in the Chronicle.

ctx.x: Ralph Gleason, yeah. Thank you. I’m forgetting good names. Ralph Gleason did a write up on that jazz album in the Chronicle. I couldn’t believe it. Everything was happening for me then. And the title says the Buddy Collette album is all you could want.
